name: Liveness
source:
In order to become the supervisor of the apartment complex she inherited from her grandfather, the protagonist Shia moved to the town of South Garden.
She started fully enjoying her comfortable at ease existence in that peaceful rural town.

Even though the people that lived there were a bunch of good for nothings, a do-S researcher, sharp tongued knight, puppy official, pompous delinquent cop, SM elder sister, shut-in bookworm, and a pervert poet.

Somehow she manages to compromise with all these too individualistic individuals and interact with them every day.
You can get used to living anywhere. You can even get used to heaven.
It was a dream come true to live a comfortable existence in that peaceful paradise of a town.

...At least it should have been.

Disconnection. Shutdown. Fire. Murder. Extinction.
The everyday was broken, It was full of the loss of important things.

Nothing is constant. I would never have wished for something like this.

	If only there was no need to meet this end--

(Translated from the official site)
translation:
為了擔任從祖父那裡繼承的公寓樓管理員，主角希雅搬到了南花園鎮。
她開始盡情享受這個寧靜鄉間小鎮舒適安逸的生活。

儘管住在那裡的人全都是一群不中用的傢伙：施虐型研究員、毒舌騎士、忠犬般的公務員、傲慢的不良警察、喜歡SM的大姊姊、足不出戶的書呆子，以及變態詩人。

不知為何，她還是設法與這些個性過強的人找到相處之道，每天共同生活。
人無論住在哪裡都能習慣，甚至連天堂也不例外。
能在這個平靜如樂園的小鎮過著舒適生活，簡直夢想成真。

……至少本該如此。

失聯。停機。火災。謀殺。滅絕。
日常崩潰了，重要的人事物接連失去。

沒有什麼永恆不變。我從未希望事情變成這樣。

如果根本不必迎來這樣的結局——

（翻譯自官方網站）
